reuse.why: Keeps the rule in the shared getScheduledAmount, which the API uses too, but re-implements the 7.5% tolerance inline instead of calling the existing getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules.

duplication.why: The approximate tolerance formula `Math.round(Math.abs(n) * 0.075)` is copied into getScheduledAmount from shared/rules.getApproxNumberThreshold.

placement.why: The amount rule sits in shared/schedules and the API field in scheduleModel.toExternal, which is the right layer, but the op is only threaded at the forecast and API sites while other schedule-amount sites (post/preview transactions, UI lists, balance) never pass it.

scope.why: Changes stay on the schedule amount helper, its tests, the API model and the forecast normaliser.

maintainability.why: A fourth positional option forces callers to spell out `false, 'roundedMidpoint'`, the 'roundedMidpoint' name now means 'lowest endpoint', and the approximate rule silently applies only where callers remember to pass the op.

bypasses_abstraction.where: packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount computes the approximate tolerance inline rather than using getApproxNumberThreshold (shared/rules.ts)

abstraction_drift.where: shared/schedules.ts getScheduledAmount gains an optional amountOp parameter and an `amountOp === 'isapprox'` branch; the 'roundedMidpoint' mode is repurposed to mean lowest endpoint while 'halfOfRoundedSum' keeps the midpoint for templates; only forecast-schedules.ts and api-models.ts pass the op
